newsitem.title: USA: Ride hit with class action suit.
newsitem.headline: Ride hit with class action suit.

text.p: Ride Inc, a maker of snowboards and related equipment, has been hit with a class-action lawsuit alleging Ride issued incorrect business information, attorneys for the plaintiff said on Monday.

In a statement, the law firms, Cohen, Milstein, Hausfeld & Toll PLLC, and Lopez & Fantel said the suit was filed on behalf of all persons who bought Ride common stock from August 10, 1995 through December 30, 1996.
The plaintiffs allege Ride issued incorrect information through material misstatements and omissions of facts about finances, performance and future business prospects.
The plaintiffs also claim this caused the market price of Ride common stock to be artificially inflated and caused purchasers to pay too much for their Ride common stock.
The case, filed by Kevin E. Murray on March 14, is pending in United States District Court for the Western District of Washington.
